title: The Fixer at the Crossroads
openingText: The fixer materializes beside your campfire as if she'd always been sitting there. 'Relax. If I wanted trouble, you'd already be having it. I move things — goods, people, information. You're carrying at least two of those. Let's talk percentages.'
dialogueCordial: See, this is nice. Everybody making money, nobody bleeding.
dialogueStrained: You're leaving value on the table. That offends me professionally.
dialogueHostile: Careful. I know what your route is worth to certain people.
dialogueWalkaway: Time is inventory, and you're spoiling mine. Gone.
dialogueAccept: Pleasure. Whatever you heard about me — this deal, I keep.

terms.description: Silt marks the smugglers' path through the checkpoint ahead — saving you 2 steps.
She'll fence your surplus salvage at 40 gold — better than any settlement rate.
A 'finder's cut' of 20 gold — buried three clauses deep.
A deniability clause: if her cargo is seized, the manifest names YOUR guild.
